rows.note: Use 奇怪 as the all-purpose choice for something odd, unusual, or not normal.

example.english: This coffee tastes sour; it’s strange.
example.traditional: 呢杯咖啡飲落有陣酸味，好奇怪。
example.jyutping: ni1 bui1 gaa3 fe1 jam2 lok6 jau5 zan6 syun1 mei6 hou2 kei4 gwaai3

rows.note: Use 陌生 when a person, place, or situation is unfamiliar because you have not encountered it before.

example.english: I’m visiting this neighborhood for the first time, so everything feels strange.
example.traditional: 我第一次去呢區，周圍都好陌生。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dai6 jat1 ci3 heoi3 ni1 keoi1 zau1 wai4 dou1 hou2 mak6 saang1
